claims: Official OpenTelemetry OTLP/HTTP preserves the root and provider child as two canonical spans
Default root promotion selects finalized root-linked application content
An explicitly selected child without a sidecar falls back to that child OTLP content, never root content
Repeated nonempty feedback IDs collapse to the latest logical event while feedback without an ID remains visible
isolation: Dedicated /tmp corpus, synthetic evidence-provider content, localhost only, no production services, customer records, external models, or message delivery
limitations: Local OTLP receiver and promotion API only; this does not exercise a remote collector or production deployment
